correctness.rationale: Exact generator equations on the two symmetry-reduced state families yield \(D_{k+1}=qD_k\). Unique normalization from \(F_0=0\), \(G_m=1\) gives the probability formula. Algebra verifies strict placement gap for \(m>1\) and the seed ratio; the \(q_m\) asymptotic expansion and uniform Riemann sums give the large-star limit. Full-state rational Markov Dirichlet elimination passed 1092 cases for all transient states with \(1\leq m\leq6\) and four rate pairs. Finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete parametric all-state classification of a natural heterogeneous contact network for a recently introduced opinion-adoption model whose biased general-topology analysis was identified as challenging. Exact hub advantage across every seed budget and positive limiting hub success versus order-\(1/m\) single-leaf success quantify structural heterogeneity beyond a numerical small-graph example.
